notes.title: Try our Next Fest Demo!!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, everyone![/h3]

We’re thrilled to share that we’ll be participating in the Steam Next Fest 2025!

Latest v0.0.8 Changelog:
[list]
[*] [b]Wands Projectiles Synergies:[/b] Each wand now features its own Auto Chess mechanic, making them even more dynamic and powerful.
[*] [b]Visual Overhaul:[/b] Enhanced materials, animations, wand spells, and overall game visuals.
[*] [b]Exploding Monsters:[/b] Adjusted explosion range and timer for better balance.
[*] [b]New Monster Spawning Algorithm:[/b] Smarter and more engaging enemy behavior.
[*] [b]Updated UI:[/b] Cleaner, more intuitive design with numerous improvements.
[*] [b]Directional Portal Arrow:[/b] A helpful arrow now guides you to the portal at the end of each round.
[/list]


We’d love for you to try the demo and add Wandness to your [i][b]Wishlist[/b][/i]: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928690/Wandness/

Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!
– Knight Owl Games and Binary Lunar

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch v0.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We just have a quick QOL Patch, thanks for your feedback :)

-You can see your wands in the pause & game over panels.
(make sure to share your build on our [url=https://discord.gg/fWVrAExjva]Discord server[/url])

- Added Hit effect when the player is hit
- You can highlight affected wands by hovering over the Wand element or class
- You can swipe wands between each others
- Added Pause \ Unpause all wands button 
- Map events size is bigger 
- Balances for enemies and projectiles
- Fixed Minor bugs

Your feedback is really important to us. You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/fWVrAExjva]Discord server[/url] to share yours.
